annotations.title: List an email-reading rule's earlier versions

description: Every version kept of a hack, newest first, with its template, senders and subject words. TrackerHacker numbers them itself: major when the template stopped reading the emails the one before read or dropped a field, minor when it reads them and more, patch when it reads the same. To go back to one, save_hack it with hackId: that's saved as the next version, so nothing is lost.
name: hack_versions
title: List an email-reading rule's earlier versions
